premises: Large-misfit solutes create heterogeneous stress fields that reduce activation energy for edge dislocation motion
Reduced activation energy enhances edge dislocation nucleation and mobility at high temperature
Enhanced edge dislocation mobility leads to increased plastic strain accommodation
Increased plastic strain accommodation improves toughness via energy dissipation and crack-tip blunting
